$comment: Cargo.lock files that have been read and accepted (WASM-013 criterion 4; ADR 0016, decision 5). Each entry pins the SHA-256 of the lock file's text (line endings as LF). A dependency update changes the lock file, which fails scripts/licence-gate.ts until the entry is changed in the same commit, so an update is always a change that somebody has to read. Direct dependencies in Cargo.toml are exact (`=x.y.z`), and every cargo command of the kernel's build runs with --locked.

crates/Cargo.lock.reviewed: WASM-016, lane w6, 2026-11-27: the crate docedit-sea-segmenter (the module of Thai, Lao, Khmer and Burmese, on owner decision 282) added to the workspace with icu_segmenter 2.4.0 (exact in its Cargo.toml) and its tree: icu_segmenter_data, icu_locale_fallback, icu_locale_fallback_data, icu_locale_core, icu_provider, icu_collections, zerovec, zerovec-derive, zerotrie, tinystr, litemap, potential_utf, writeable, displaydoc, utf8_iter, utf_types, core_maths, libm, and serde with serde_core and serde_derive (listed in the lock by optional dependencies; the module is built without the serde feature); 22 packages added, 52 in all.
